Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral, patchy, peripheral opacities (highlighted by the yellow circles) which are characteristic of the migratory consolidations seen in organizing pneumonia (formerly BOOP), distinguishing it from the typically lobar pattern of community-acquired pneumonia or the diffuse patterns of acute eosinophilic pneumonia.
